# Dr Paul McCarthy | Sport Psychologist

> Expert sport psychology consulting helping athletes and executives maximize mental performance through evidence-based interventions across the UK and Ireland.

Dr Paul McCarthy is a qualified sport psychologist based in Glasgow offering specialized mental performance coaching for various sports including football, golf, rugby, and tennis, as well as executive coaching services. His practice utilizes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and mental skills training to help athletes overcome performance anxiety, build confidence, and achieve peak performance.
